info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Warehouse Inventory Audits-v4-spec
info.description: The Warehouse Inventory Audit API provides access to a comprehensive list of inventory audit records within warehouses. It enables users to monitor and review past inventory transactions, ensuring compliance and accuracy in inventory management. Typical consumers of this API include warehouse managers, compliance officers, and inventory analysts who rely on historical data for audits, reporting, and operational improvements. Through this API, businesses can enhance their inventory oversight and streamline auditing processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the audit records of the inventory, providing insights into stock changes, adjustments, and discrepancies over a specified period.

requestBody.description: The JSON payload used to request the inventory audit data. This payload contains all necessary parameters to retrieve the audit information and should conform to the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the audit inventory data.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsRequest.description: A string representation of the inventory audit request body for the GET operation.

resultId.description: The ID of the result associated with the operation.

audit.description: Details about the audit related to this operation.

ListWarehouseInventoryAuditsResponse_200.description: Response schema for GET operation on inventory audit.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit was generated automatically.
